caption: The drawing depicts a single brass candlestick holder centered on a plain background. The candlestick holder consists of a wide, shallow, circular base with a raised edge, which reflects light in shades of yellow, gold, and brown. Rising from the center of the base is a vertical cylindrical shaft with decorative bands and a knobbed section near the bottom, tapering into the base. The shaft features an adjustable lever with a leaf-shaped end protruding horizontally on one side. The top of the shaft is wider, forming a cup-like holder for a candle. The drawing uses gradients of yellow, gold, and muted brown to render the metallic appearance and dimensionality of the object, with fine hatch marks and shading indicating highlights and shadows. The entire composition is framed with a fine black outline, and the artist’s name, “JANET RIZA,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
